summary: Package exports an OpenSSL-encrypted opaque blob as a library value
details: thedata@1.0.5 is a minimal npm package whose only runtime code reads a ~48 KB file `apps/docs/app/des.db` and re-exports its contents as the string `desKey` from `index.js`. The file begins with the base64 marker `U2FsdGVkX1` (`Salted__`), indicating an OpenSSL-encrypted payload. The package performs no network I/O, no `exec`/`eval`, no credential or filesystem reads beyond its own shipped file, and declares no install lifecycle scripts (`preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`/`prepare`). `index.js` also re-exports an `rsaKey` symbol that is not defined in `theta.js`. Installing or importing this package does not by itself execute or decrypt the blob; the package is a carrier of opaque encrypted data under a generic name with placeholder Next.js/Turborepo scaffolding.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
